name: Juggler Stone
source:
Collecting all three juggler stones is supposed to bring great power.
Main character acquires one stone by chance and heads to Alpha Town to find traces of the other two with the help of characters met along the way.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1985.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
据说，只要集齐三颗杂耍之石，就能获得强大的力量。
主人公偶然得到其中一颗，于是前往阿尔法镇，在沿途结识的人们的帮助下，寻找另外两颗的线索。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1985.html]vndbreview[/url]]
